signs_and_coordinates: Build a single-phase-input permanent-magnet synchronous motor drive.
A single-phase AC source must feed a rectifier and smoothing DC link, which must feed a controllable three-phase inverter supplying a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine.

The physically measured inverter output frequency must follow F_cmd, and the physical rotor speed must change in the same direction as the commanded frequency while the three motor-side phases remain balanced.
feedback_and_control_causality: A single-phase AC source must feed a rectifier and smoothing DC link, which must feed a controllable three-phase inverter supplying a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine.
signal_sources: F_cmd is read from the public MATLAB base-workspace input contract.
Wm is produced by the implemented plant or controller and logged under the public output contract.
